messages:
maria (sec-eng): Heads-up, seeing a small but growing spike in inter-region mTLS handshake failures starting ~03:10 UTC this morning. Mostly APAC->EU east-west traffic. Failures correlate with cert-rotator KMS RBAC tighten rolled out at 02:45 UTC. Logs show KMS decrypt denies during issuance. Can we triage?

ashwin (infra): on it. which services are hitting failures? any sample logs?

maria (sec-eng): Frontend proxies and model-routing svc have most hits. paste of a typical error from proxy logs:

```
2026-03-23T03:12:14Z proxy-1 ERROR tls_handshake: failed to assemble cert chain: KMS_DECRYPT_DENIED, key=projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/rotator/cryptoKeys/edge-key
peer=10.40.5.12 region=ap-southeast1 target=eu-west1
```

maria (sec-eng): Also seeing cert-rotator-bot alert: "cert-rotator: rotation job 2026-03-23T02:46 failed for apac-pool: KMS decrypt denied"

ellie (sre): can you confirm if keystore replication lag or TTL change is involved? Last deploy touched keystore TTLs (cf. #keystore-ttl PR).

maria (sec-eng): replication looks fine per storage metrics, TTL unchanged. RBAC change was: removed broad serviceAccount:redwood-rotator@ from roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter and replaced with per-region role-binding. The intent was least privilege, but maybe the binding didn't apply in ap-southeast1.

ashwin (infra): I pulled audit logs from KMS: found multiple "PermissionDenied: cloudkms.cryptoKeyVersions.useToDecrypt" entries around 02:46-03:15 UTC for principal serviceAccount:rotator-apac@redwood. Sample cloud audit line:

```
protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail: "rotator-apac@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com"
protoPayload.status: { code: 7, message: "Permission denied: cloudkms.cryptoKeyVersions.useToDecrypt" }
resourceName: "projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/rotator/cryptoKeys/edge-key/cryptoKeyVersions/3"
```

ashwin (infra): Looks like the regional SA never got the role in one region due to an infra automation bug. Oncall runbook suggests: rebind role and force a short backfill rotation.

sam (oncall): I can rebind now. Command I used in a previous incident:

```
gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding edge-key \
  --keyring=rotator --location=global \
  --member=serviceAccount:rotator-apac@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com \
  --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter
```

sam (oncall): rebind done in ap-southeast1. cert-rotator triggered a retry; I see successful decrypts at 03:20 UTC and TLS handshakes dropping back to baseline. :thumbsup:

maria (sec-eng): nice. any risk of stale cached certs failing once rotation continues? we should ensure fallback to cached keys if KMS flaps again.

ellie (sre): suggest temporary mitigations: 1) extend cert cache TTL on proxies by +15m to smooth transient flaps, 2) enable fallback to last-known-good cert for 2 rotations, 3) add alert that ties mTLS handshake failure rate to KMS PermissionDenied count.

ashwin (infra): long term: update automation to verify region-specific IAM bindings after rollout (post-deploy check), and add an audit query that runs every 5m to detect any principal with DENIED in last 10m.

maria (sec-eng): agree. action items for postmortem:
- root cause: infra automation created per-region SA but failed to bind role in ap-southeast1
- short term: sam rebounded role and forced retry (done)
- immediate mitigations: ellie's TTL/fallback changes, updated alarm mapping KMS denies -> pager
- long term: add preflight IAM verify in rotator CI, and cross-region role whistle test

sam (oncall): I'll open the incident ticket and assign follow-ups. tagging @ashwin and @ellie for fixes and @maria for postmortem notes.

cert-rotator-bot: alert cleared: rotation retry succeeded for apac-pool at 2026-03-23T03:20:42Z.

maria (sec-eng): also we should capture an example audit link for the pm: https://console.cloud.google.com/logs/query;query=protoPayload.status.message%3D%22Permission%20denied%22%20AND%20resource.labels.key_ring_id%3Drotator

ellie (sre): will add dashboards: 1) handshake-failures by region, 2) KMS PermissionDenied count, 3) rotator-job success rate. will PR TTL/fallback config after lunch.

maria (sec-eng): thanks all. adding notes to the incident channel and drafting a short blameless postmortem. :eyes:
